thesis: Frame the song as a high-energy anthem where bold crowd-wide coverage and bright chorus peaks celebrate collective identity, with disciplined contrast to keep each hook impactful.

artist_branding.summary: David Guetta and Sia map to mainstream festival-pop dance language: immediate hook clarity, strong rise-and-release dynamics, and emotional singalong moments that need readable large-scale lighting.
visual_cues: Big-room symmetry and broad audience-facing sweeps
High-contrast chorus lift moments with cleaner whites and warm accents
Confident kinetic pacing that supports anthem-style vocal delivery
do_not_copy: Do not reproduce exact choreographic signatures, branded stage designs, or direct re-creation of known tour cue stacks.

motifs: Geometry motif: inclusive full-room fan-outs that repeatedly regroup at center
Color motif: vibrant cool base with warm-gold and white chorus affirmation
Movement motif: energetic bar-quantized sweeps with clearer punch in chorus/drop phrases

visual_direction.color_story: Use cool-to-warm interplay for momentum, then emphasize white and gold in hook peaks for anthem readability.
visual_direction.motion_story: Keep movement assertive and legible: medium-fast directional transitions in high-energy sections, with brief decompression in verse resets.
visual_direction.staging_story: Treat PARs as crowd glue and movers as chorus amplifiers; prioritize audience-facing presence in peak lines without flattening dynamic range.

must_include: Clear hook-level visual lift distinct from surrounding bars
Wide room-coverage moments that read as collective celebration
Phrase-aware contrast enforcement between verse and chorus/drop
avoid: Monochrome-only treatment through the full arrangement
Continuous high-speed strobe that obscures vocal intelligibility
Dense visual clutter that competes with lead-vocal moments
